title: glochidion oxycarpum

This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions that can aid in wound healing and reduce fever. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy and potential side effects.
